rule: top-level `file.fun` (file basename); nested modules/functors dotted (`file.Make.connect`); local function lets `outer.f`, local value lets fold into the enclosing binding; module-level code's caller is the module. Names resolve in definition order through local bindings, local opens, enclosing structures and their opens/includes, module aliases (`module F = Filegen.Make (P)`) and dune library wrappers (`Functoria.DSL`); then Stdlib (`Stdlib.invalid_arg`), the innermost external local open, the one external open (medium); `List.length` medium; applying a parameter is unknown.
notes: Nested modules are dotted under the file module: `store.Cache.get`, `store.Cache.Stats.hit`. Bare names inside a nested structure resolve through enclosing structures: `log` in Cache → `store.log`, `key` → `store.Cache.key`, `get` in Stats → `store.Cache.get`. Qualified `Cache.get` / `Cache.Stats.hit` from the file's top level resolve to the same IDs (C1).
